outcome: One sentence naming what is true when this is done, phrased as something a user can observe rather than something the code contains.
scope: Each line is work this contract covers.
Write these before the first edit. They are what the maker is allowed to touch.
exclusions: Each line is work this contract does not cover, however tempting it looks from inside the change.
A contract that excludes nothing has not been thought about, and loop-lint refuses it.

verification.check: the new behaviour is covered, and nothing else regressed
the whole check chain is green on this tree
a person looked at the surface and it is not merely correct
verification.observation: screenshot or note recorded in the feature's evidence
